summary: Delivered the PH-291 cross-domain read-only operations reconciliation overview in the delivery layer, then fixed the three independent-review blockers. The new `pmo_plugins/delivery/operations_read_services.py` exposes `ops_reconciliation_overview(member, *, as_of=None, period=None)` aggregating already-delivered owner facts into six sections: contracts (pending changes / terminated contracts / approved lines still active under terminated contracts), settlement (active open items, over-cleared items, refunds, bank returns, refunds without matching clearance, derived remaining balance; for pm, refunds/bank-returns and their totals are strictly scoped to cash facts that actually cleared the pm-visible open items so no other project's amounts leak), management revenue (posted/reversed recognitions, terminated-still-recognized, recognized vs settled net difference), time (pending/confirmed billable confirmations, confirmed minutes, unapproved timesheets; for pm, confirmations are scoped through the canonical time-owner UUID5 of visible Timesheet pks - `uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, 'pmo:timesheet:<pk>')` - not raw contract-line ids), onboarding (PH-274 preview is stateless -> counts/totals null plus `import_preview_persistence_not_implemented`), and cash (posted/missing classification/net; pm null plus `cash_not_scoped_to_project`). Roles: owner/finance/auditor full, pm managed/visible projects, member denied; the route is declared canonically in `pmo_plugins/delivery/domain_metadata.py` as `history_read` (urls.py imports it, no metadata copy), so history reads survive module disable. Everything is read-only: no writes, audit, receipts, session persistence, migration or second insights owner; tests assert derived values, null-plus-missing semantics, ref caps, period/as_of filtering, role/scope isolation including pm refund and pm time regressions, invalid inputs, module-disabled history, and zero INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE SQL with unchanged fact/audit/event counts. 17 scoped tests added.
